item.title: The prophecy of the priest
item.description: This is not an attempt to condemn them nor to call anybody out. This is my witness of two lives unfolding over decades. There is no single great act of treachery in this story. Just a slow accumulation of deferral and miscommunication. This couple is still together. I wish them the best in life. I do not want others to suffer the way this couple has.

item.title: What does Sola Scriptura mean?
item.description: Sola Scriptura. Scripture alone. Many people use this to describe their faith. Here, we take a look at what that actually means and why its practical implementation is impossible without Divine Assistance.
